title: Effect of PAC-embedded fillers coupled with electrochemical systems on nitrogen transfer pathways and removal
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00610D, Paper
Zhaoxu Peng, Meiqi He, Yingjian Zhang, Likun Gu, Yan Wang, Liyun Sun, Lulu Cheng
To improve electron donor use in low-C/N wastewater nitrogen removal, PVA–SA/PAC composite fillers were developed for four lab-scale biofilters treating grit/clarifier synthetic effluents.
